description: This file defines structures, enums, and function prototypes for low-level 3-way in-core file merging, including options configuration and merge execution functions.

methods.name: ll_merge
methods.description: Performs a three-way single-file merge, returning a result code indicating success, conflict, or error.

methods.name: ll_merge_marker_size
methods.description: Returns the size of conflict markers for a given file.

methods.name: reset_merge_attributes
methods.description: Resets merge-related attributes to default states.
